summary: Suite 48/49 at the host run; a full re-run gave 48/49 again but with a different failure, so two tests are flaky in full-suite runs while passing alone (Jump in wave 4/4 alone, 3/3 in a double-wave loop). Berry race W/A/D tests pass.

failures.what: Flaky: the second E wave does not make the creature follow (it stays in :answer)
failures.steps: Run the whole suite (live_tests()); 'Jump in: E waves and a creature answers, a second wave makes it follow' failed at the host run with 'Pinchy does not follow after the second wave (answer)'. Run alone 4 of 4 passes; a loop of 3 wave-twice trials also followed each time.
failures.expected: Two waves within 12 s at the same creature make it follow Sprout.
failures.actual: In the full suite the creature still answers after the second wave (the second wave probably went to another creature or the 12 s window was missed). I added world time, greeted table and all answering/following creatures to the check message so the next failure shows which.

failures.what: Flaky: Flower gift: the flower is still drawn after the gift
failures.steps: Full suite re-run (live_tests()) after the host run: 'Flower gift: a critter carries a picked flower to a friend, who thanks it with hearts' failed with 'the flower is still drawn after the gift'. It passed in the host run.
failures.expected: After the gift the carried flower plot is gone.
failures.actual: The flower is still drawn at the check.
